messages:
maya: Dropping a new compact+dense mock for credentials. Trying to balance info density with keyboard access. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/cred-dense
tony: Nice direction. One immediate Q: how do we expose rotate/revoke without expanding rows? I want 1-click for common ops.
rachel: Could put small text CTAs on the right: 'Rotate' and 'Disable' as link-buttons. Keeps height small but exposes actions.
samir: Link-buttons are fine if focusable. Make sure the target hit area meets 44px on mobile. Also avoid tiny icons only.
diego: UX thought: show scopes inline as abbreviated tokens e.g. `read`, `write`, `admin` limited to 2 with +N indicator. Clicking expands to full chips.
maya: Love that. Another piece: TTL presets in the create flow. Propose 15m, 24h, 90d. Add a tooltip: 'Shorter TTL reduces blast radius.'
tony: For rotate modal copy: change from 'Rotate key now?' to 'Rotate credential and issue a new token. The previous token will be invalid immediately.' Adds clarity.
rachel: Revoke language: prefer 'Disable access' over 'revoke' for broader audiences. Also show a small line: 'This blocks new requests; active sessions may continue until expiry.'
a11y-bot: Accessibility checks: 1) Provide visible focus styles for row actions; 2) Ensure `Rotate` and `Disable` use accessible names and are not icon-only; 3) Token reveal must be a toggle with `aria-pressed` and aria-label like 'Show token value'.
samir: Bulk actions: avoid modal keyword confirmations. Soft-disable + toast with Undo (15m) is friendlier. Also log audit entry with actor and reason.
diego: Empty state idea: instead of solo CTA, show two starter personas: 'CI service token' and 'Developer token' with short examples and prefilled scopes. Lowers friction.
maya: On create success, focus must move to the new token card and the copy button should get focus. Screen readers should hear 'Token created. Press Enter to copy.' via aria-live polite.
tony: Contrast nit: danger button red currently fails 4.5:1 at small sizes. Use an outline + icon + text fallback. Don't rely on color alone.
rachel: Copy tweak for rotate CTA: primary = 'Rotate and copy new token', secondary = 'Rotate without copying'. Helps quick workflows.
a11y-bot: Also ensure keyboard order: header -> filters -> list -> row actions -> paginator. Test with keyboard-only walkthroughs.
samir: Perf note: in compact mode, prefer text abbreviations for scopes instead of inline SVGs; expand on hover/expand. Saves paint time on long lists.
maya: Good call. I'll iterate and post v2 with the link-buttons, recipes in empty state, TTL presets copy, and the focus/aria behaviors. Ping me for a pairing session on keyboard flow tests. :rocket:
